newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Terra Mining says in early merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Terra Mining says in early merger talks.

text.p: Swedish mining company Terra Mining on Tuesday said it was in discussions with an unnamed company over a possible merger.
Trading in Terra Mining was suspended on the Stockholm bourse on Monday with its shares last traded at 140 crowns.
"The company during 1996 has been contacted by different mining companies which wanted to discuss the possibility of an eventual merger," Terra Mining said in a statement.
"Terra Mining has now begun preliminary discussions with one of these companies."
The company said it was too early to release any details of these talks.
Terra Mining has two gold mines, Bjorkdal in Sweden from which it produced 71,292 ounces of gold in calendar 1995 and a new mine Pahtavaara in Finland.
